ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERCOUNTRYOFCITIZENSHIP_CCD] AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship AS 
(
SELECT 
	BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
	,BCD.CUST_NATIONALITY_CDE AS CountryId
	,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT  AS PeriodStartDate
	,CONVERT(DATE,'9999-12-31') AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS NationalId
	,NULL AS PassportId
	,NULL AS CitizenshipTypeId
	,BCD.CUST_NATIONALITY AS NationalityId
	,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
	,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS [InsertDttm]
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD WHERE BCD.ISLATEST = 1 AND BCD.CUST_NBR IS NOT NULL 

UNION ALL

SELECT
	BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
	,BCD.CUST_NATIONALITY_CDE AS CountryId
	,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT  AS PeriodStartDate
	,CONVERT(DATE,'9999-12-31') AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS NationalId
	,NULL AS PassportId
	,NULL AS CitizenshipTypeId
	,BCD.CUST_NATIONALITY AS NationalityId
	,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
	,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS [InsertDttm]
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD 
where BCD.ISLATEST = 1 AND BCD.CUST_NBR IS NOT NULL
)


SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(varchar,CountryId)
,convert(varchar,NationalityId)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
,convert(varchar,SourceSystemCode)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, CountryId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship
)

,
TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(varchar,CountryId)
,convert(varchar,NationalityId)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
,convert(varchar,SourceSystemCode)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, CountryId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship WHERE PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31' AND SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'	
)
,
TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.CountryId,TGT.CountryId) AS CountryId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
    WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'    
	WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.CountryId = TGT.CountryId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL 
)

SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA;

------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(day,-1,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate)))
FROM BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship TGT
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.CountryId = TGT.CountryId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.CountryId = TGT.CountryId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31' AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD';


-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship
(
	CustomerId
	,CountryId
	,PeriodStartDate
	,PeriodEndDate
	,NationalId
	,PassportId
	,CitizenshipTypeId
	,NationalityId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm

)
SELECT
	SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
	,SRC.CountryId AS CountryId
    ,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	,PeriodEndDate
	,NationalId
	,PassportId
	,CitizenshipTypeId
	,SRC.NationalityId AS NationalityId
	,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship SRC
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId AND DELTA.CountryId = SRC.CountryId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship;
DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA;

END

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERCOUNTRYOFCITIZENSHIP_CRM] AS
BEGIN

--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship AS (
SELECT 
	BCD.ORGKEY AS CustomerId
	,NULL AS CountryId
	,BCD.TMDATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
	,BCA.STRUSERFIELD17 AS NationalId
	,NULL AS PassportId
	,NULL AS CitizenshipTypeId
	,BCD.NATIONALITY AS NationalityId
	,BCD.Source_Code AS SourceSystemCode
	,BCD.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC BCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS BCA  ON BCD.ORGKEY = BCA.ORGKEY
WHERE BCD.ORGKEY IS NOT NULL AND BCD.isLatest = '1'

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_SRC AS (
SELECT 
    HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
	convert(varchar,CustomerId)
	,convert(varchar,CountryId)
	,convert(varchar,NationalId)
	,convert(varchar,NationalityId)
	,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
	,convert(varchar,SourceSystemCode)
	)) HASHROW, CustomerId, CountryId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_TGT AS (
SELECT  
    HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
	convert(varchar,CustomerId)
	,convert(varchar,CountryId)
	,convert(varchar,NationalId)
	,convert(varchar,NationalityId)
	,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
	,convert(varchar,SourceSystemCode)
	)) HASHROW, CustomerId, CountryId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship
WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM' AND (PeriodEndDate IS NULL OR PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31')
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA AS (
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.CountryId,TGT.CountryId) AS CountryId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
    WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'    
	WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.CountryId = TGT.CountryId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL 
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA;


---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
[PeriodEndDate] = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, SRC.PeriodStartDate)) 
FROM BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.CountryId = TGT.CountryId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.CountryId = TGT.CountryId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE (TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL OR TGT.PeriodEndDate  = '9999-12-31' ) AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'CRM';


-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship (
[CustomerId]
,[CountryId]
,[PeriodStartDate]
,[PeriodEndDate]
,[NationalId]
,[PassportId]
,[CitizenshipTypeId]
,[NationalityId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	SRC.CustomerId
	,SRC.CountryId
	,PeriodStartDate
	,PeriodEndDate
	,NationalId
	,PassportId
	,CitizenshipTypeId
	,SRC.NationalityId
	,'CRM' AS SourceSystemCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId AND DELTA.CountryId = SRC.CountryId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA;

END

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERCOUNTRYOFCITIZENSHIP_SEC] AS
BEGIN


--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH
TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED
AS
(
    SELECT BSC.CLTCODE, BSA.DATE_OPEN, BSA.ACCTCODE  FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BSA 
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK BSL ON BSA.ACCTCODE = BSL.ACCTKEY AND BSA.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSL.ISLATEST = 1
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSL.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1
)
, 
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship
AS(
	SELECT 
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
	,NATIONALITY AS CountryId
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS NationalId
	,NULL AS PassportId
	,NULL AS CitizenshipTypeId
	,NULL AS NationalityId
	,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS [InsertDttm]
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE	
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC 
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE
WHERE BSC.ISLATEST = 1

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
    HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
	convert(varchar,CustomerId)
	,convert(varchar,CountryId)
	,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
	,convert(varchar,SourceSystemCode)
	)) HASHROW, CustomerId, CountryId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
    HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
	convert(varchar,CustomerId)
	,convert(varchar,CountryId)
	,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
	,convert(varchar,SourceSystemCode)
	)) HASHROW, CustomerId, CountryId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship WHERE PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31' AND SourceSystemCode = 'SEC'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.CountryId,TGT.CountryId) AS CountryId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
    WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'    
	WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.CountryId = TGT.CountryId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
[PeriodEndDate] =  CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(day,-1,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate)))
FROM BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.CountryId = TGT.CountryId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.CountryId = TGT.CountryId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31' AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'SEC';

-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship  ( 
[CustomerId]
,[CountryId]
,[PeriodStartDate]
,[PeriodEndDate]
,[NationalId]
,[PassportId]
,[CitizenshipTypeId]
,[NationalityId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT 
 SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SRC.CountryId AS CountryId
,PeriodStartDate AS PeriodStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
,NULL AS NationalId
,NULL AS PassportId
,NULL AS CitizenshipTypeId
,SRC.NationalityId AS NationalityId
,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId AND DELTA.CountryId = SRC.CountryId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA;

END
